items.text: No-exam life insurance exists in two kinds. Simplified issue asks a few health questions. Guaranteed issue asks none, but usually pays less in the first years. Ask which one you are being offered. (571) 354-0146
items.image_alt: Honorbrook Insurance graphic. Two kinds of no-exam life insurance. Simplified issue: A few health questions, no exam; May pay the full benefit from day one. Guaranteed issue: No health questions at all; Usually pays a reduced benefit in the first years.

items.text:
"No medical exam" covers two quite different products, and the difference matters.

Simplified issue policies skip the exam but ask several health questions. If your answers are favorable, you may qualify for a full benefit from day one.

Guaranteed issue policies ask no health questions at all, so anyone in the eligible age range can be accepted. The trade-off is that they commonly pay a reduced benefit if death occurs in the first two or three years, and the coverage amounts tend to be smaller.

Neither is better in the abstract. For someone in good health, simplified issue is often the stronger value. For someone who has been declined elsewhere, guaranteed issue can be the right answer.

The question to ask any agent is simple: which of these am I being offered, and when does the full benefit begin?

We explain it plainly and we will tell you if you do not need a policy at all.

Honorbrook Insurance, Tysons VA. (571) 354-0146 honorbrook-insurance.com

Medicare's Annual Enrollment Period runs October 15 – December 7.

This is the yearly window when anyone with Medicare can review their coverage and make changes. Changes you make take effect January 1.

Plans can change their costs, drug lists, and provider networks from one year to the next, so it's worth looking over your Annual Notice of Change when it arrives. If you'd like a second set of eyes on it, we're happy to walk through it with you in plain English, with no pressure.

Honorbrook Insurance is an independent agency. We work for you, not for one insurance company.

Tap Call to talk with Luay.

We do not offer every plan available in your area. Any information we provide is limited to those plans we do offer. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.

Read the Annual Notice of Change your plan mailed; Confirm every prescription is still on the drug list; Confirm your doctors and hospital are still in network; Confirm your pharmacy is still a good fit.

items.text: Before buying life insurance, ask what it is for. Paying off a mortgage, covering a funeral and replacing income are three jobs, often three policies. (571) 354-0146
Coverage through work usually ends when the job does. Worth knowing before you decide you do not need a policy of your own. honorbrook-insurance.com
